description: The campaign a world gives (genre-strategy): generate = campaignForWorld({...world, strategy}, tuning) (the pack tunables claimCoin, upkeepFood, startingCoin, startingFood and workersPerHolding stand in for core's defaults where the authored section has no rows) with campaignFacts and campaignWorldFacts; books = turnBooks (strategy_net/3 in TypeScript); claimCost; controlled = controlledSettlements for every faction; adjacency = settlementAdjacency.
sources: Rules: core's puzzle, platformer and strategy modules (src/puzzle, src/platformer, src/strategy) and their directors (src/game-engine/logic/{Puzzle,Platformer,Strategy}Director.ts), unchanged by this corpus; their predicate packs are pinned clause by clause by conformance/prolog/mechanic-{puzzle,platformer,strategy}.json.

Worlds: the committed slice of Thistlecombe (Unity closing-wave export, conformance/genre-mechanics/thistlecombe.world-slice.json) and synthetic worlds written in src/genre-systems/systems-corpus-cases.ts.
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip
